verdict.rationale: smolagents is an open-source Python library that runs agents in the user's own environment. It operates no vendor-managed data storage, so choosing a storage region is not an axis this kind of product offers. Running local models via transformers or ollama, or pushing agents to the Hugging Face Hub, are user-side or host-platform choices, not a residency feature of the library itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
